description: Captured regression scenarios replayed on every CI build to prevent recurrence.

scenarios.name: silent_truncation_at_1000
scenarios.description: Fetching a restaurant with >1000 items was silently capped at 1000 when pagination loop exited early. Items 1001+ were never returned.
scenarios.trigger: MENU_ITEMS_REPO_MAX_PAGES=1 with a restaurant that has 3262 items
scenarios.expected_behavior: API must return item_count > 1000, or if capped, must 503 with explicit truncation error, never silently return fewer items than exist

scenarios.name: fallback_masking_db_error
scenarios.description: When DB paginates and page 2 throws, ALLOW_FALLBACK_ON_DB_ERROR=true would silently return partial results from cache. Caller could not distinguish partial data from full data.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Must return 503 with source db_error. Must NOT return 200 with partial items.

scenarios.name: count_parity_broken_concurrent
scenarios.description: Under 10 concurrent requests for the same large-menu restaurant, DB count, API count, and frontend count drifted. This indicates a race condition or cache inconsistency.
scenarios.expected_behavior: All concurrent responses must return identical item_count. DB raw rows must equal API count. No variance allowed.

scenarios.name: regression_trap_control_flow
scenarios.description: Route was returning fallback source on DB errors instead of 503. DB errors were being masked as successful responses with stale cache data.
scenarios.trigger: Simulated DB error injected via makeSupabaseQuery factory
scenarios.expected_behavior: DB error must produce 503 with source=db_error. item_count for large restaurant must never be 0 or capped at 1000 when 3262 rows exist.
scenarios.test_ref: regression trap: blocks silent truncation in fullMenuRoute.controlFlow.test.js

scenarios.name: fallback_cache_poison
scenarios.description: If a poisoned/truncated result is written to the fallback cache, then DB becomes unavailable, all subsequent fallback reads return corrupted data indefinitely.
scenarios.trigger: Write poisoned cache, then DB throws on all requests
scenarios.expected_behavior: In strict mode (ALLOW_FALLBACK_ON_DB_ERROR=false): 503 must be returned, never poisoned cache. In loose mode: fallback should serve only if the cached count matches last known DB count.

scenarios.name: production_config_drift_unsafe_fallback_flag
scenarios.description: Production deployment accidentally set ALLOW_FALLBACK_ON_DB_ERROR=true, enabling fallback masking under DB error conditions.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Startup must hard fail with MENU_INTEGRITY_RUNTIME_POLICY_BLOCKED.
scenarios.test_ref: blocks unsafe fallback masking config in production in menuIntegrityRuntimeGuard.test.js

scenarios.name: stale_lkg_baseline_hides_latency_drift
scenarios.description: A stale baseline can let severe p95 latency regression drift through unless latency hard gate is enabled.
scenarios.trigger: ENFORCE_LATENCY_REGRESSION=true with previous baseline p95 significantly lower than current
scenarios.expected_behavior: Gate must hard fail with p95 latency regression evidence and explicit baseline/current values.
scenarios.test_ref: BLOCKED: p95 latency regression in releaseGateMenuIntegrity.mjs

scenarios.name: diagnostics_rate_limit_abuse
scenarios.description: Burst requests against admin diagnostics can become an amplification vector if no route-level limiter is enforced.
scenarios.trigger: Repeated GET /api/admin/menu-integrity/diagnostics above configured max per minute
scenarios.expected_behavior: Endpoint must return HTTP 429 with rate-limit message once threshold is exceeded.
scenarios.test_ref: Too many diagnostics requests. Please slow down. in menu.js

scenarios.name: diagnostics_payload_overload_summary_degrade
scenarios.description: Large diagnostics payloads can degrade availability if full payload rendering is always attempted.
scenarios.trigger: Large diagnostics history with low summary-only threshold
scenarios.expected_behavior: Endpoint must return summary_only=true and degraded_reason=payload_too_large.
